qt: to the Commission Geadis Geadi (ECR) Subject:

There has been a significant increase in the use of electric scooters on European roads. This has coincided with the occurrence of serious accidents and death. Of particular concern is their use by minors, as well as the risks to pedestrians and other road users. The use of electric bicycles for food delivery also poses a safety issue. The Commission has announced that it is preparing a set of guidelines on the safe use of personal mobility devices. In view of the above: 1.
When does the Commission intend to publish these guidelines and will they also cover electric bicycles used for deliveries?

Does the Commission intend to consider joint recommendations on the safety requirements for companies that make electric scooters available for use in public spaces, as well as for companies that use electric bicycles for deliveries?
